sectionHeadings: 135 — Fast CI as Default + Crates Workspace Convergence
FR-02: `make ci-strict` exists and matches previous `make ci`
FR-03: `make ci` is the previous `make ci-fast`; `ci-fast` removed
FR-06: `validate-and-fix` calls `make ci` as the dev-loop default
SC-02: `make ci` wall-time matches previous `make ci-fast`
record.summary: Amend spec 104 to (a) collapse the per-manifest crates/* loop in `ci-rust` into a single `cargo --workspace` invocation, closing the ghost-crate validation gap permanently in the parity-bound recipe, and (b) reverse the semantic positions of `make ci` and `make ci-fast`. After this spec, `make ci` is the fast parallel local validation (≈ 5 min warm) used as the daily dev loop, and `make ci-strict` is the parity-mirror recipe (90+ min) used pre-merge for release verification or when investigating parity drift. The `ci-parity-check` binding follows the rename.
record.title: Fast CI as Default — Crates Workspace Convergence + Target Rename
